context: Owner approved continuation and publication after the implementation/specification status handoff. This is additive to the exact editorial approval, not a change to its immutable bytes.
release_conditions: Exact candidate preserves approved content, source uncertainty, rights and attribution.
No known blocking data-loss, wrong-content, signature or unsafe-network failures.
Required shared and native integration checks pass with evidence and limitations recorded.
Production changes use the current remote baseline and only reviewed public runtime paths.
One shared editorial approval applies to both platforms; platform tests remain separate.
Website exposes only the latest active Android artifact; existing audience is preserved.
Device installation requires the actual Nemus iPhone to be available; no silent substitution.
not_authorized_by_inference: Resume the explicitly paused liturgical text work.
Publish synthetic or unverified 2027/calendar data or future unreviewed content.
Change rights claims, add unverified charity logos, or contact organizations.
Public Play Store/App Store distribution or broaden the test audience.
Automatically approve or publish future monitor findings.
Choose a new external private reporting destination or paid service without resolving that choice.
Delete unrelated user changes, reset repositories, or reinstall by removing existing app data.

delivery.note: Actual delivery is recorded by later signed manifests, deployment results and device readback, never by this authorization.
